يبتلعوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلِعُوا (yabtaliʕū) /jab.ta.li.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# يُبْتَلَعُوا (yubtalaʕū) /jub.ta.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
